location: Wangaratta, North-East Victoria (Ovens & King Region), Australia

main_turf.surface: Turf (Kikuyu and Rye grass blend on well-draining Ovens Valley sandy loam)
main_turf.stretch_length: 350 metres (20m track width) — 3.0m uphill climb to the winning post
main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). One of Victoria's most technical undulating country circuits. Features a distinct 4.25-metre downhill descent from the 1000m mark to the 600m mark that naturally accelerates mid-race tempo, followed by a sweeping cambered home turn and a testing 3.0-metre uphill climb through the entire 350m home straight. Pure tearaway leaders ('E') that go too fast down the 1000m-600m hill frequently hit a brick wall on the uphill straight. Balanced on-pace stalkers ('P') and strong-striding momentum swoopers ('S') that slingshot off the turn thrive.
main_turf.post_bias: INSIDE-TO-MIDDLE DRAW EDGE IN SPRINTS / FAIR ON ROUTES: In 1000m, 1100m, and 1170m sprint dashes, barriers 1 through 6 allow runners to hold cover down the hill before the home turn. Over 1300m, 1400m, 1590m, and 2000m routes, starting chutes provide fair run-ups.

handicapping_angles.downhill_1000m_to_600m_and_uphill_350m_s: SIGNATURE WANGARATTA PHYSICS: The course drops 4.25m between the 1000m and 600m before climbing 3.0m uphill to the finish post. Heavily penalize one-dimensional front-runners ('E') caught in a speed battle down the hill (-2.5 pts). Upgrade tactical stalkers ('P') and proven Wangaratta track specialists (+3.5 pts).
handicapping_angles.ben_brisbourne_and_lindsay_park_euroa_do: Wangaratta is the home track of high-volume trainer Ben Brisbourne, and sits just up the Hume Freeway from Lindsay Park's Euroa training estate (Ben, Will & JD Hayes) plus Wodonga/Albury yards (Craig Widdison, Mitchell Beer, Andrew Dale, Dan McCarthy) and Melbourne metro shippers (Ciaron Maher, Patrick & Michelle Payne, Griffiths & de Kock). Upgrade Lindsay Park and Melbourne metro droppers (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.cutaway_rail_and_portable_rail_shifts: When the portable rail is moved out (Out 3m to 7m), monitor cutaway rail availability at the top of the 350m straight — box-seat stalkers ('P') tracking the leader from barriers 1-4 gain a golden inside run.
handicapping_angles.murray_river_cross_border_direction_swit: Wangaratta runs Anti-Clockwise (Left-Handed). Horses shipping across the Murray River from NSW Clockwise tracks (Albury, Wagga, Corowa) must handle switching back to the left-handed Victorian leg.
handicapping_angles.wangaratta_cup_carnival_class: During the March Wangaratta Cup ($100k+) carnival, field quality spikes to Melbourne Midweek Metro / Provincial BM70-BM84 standard.
